notes: The Copilot counterpart of corrupt-state-pending: the same unparseable gate_pending block map, but Copilot must exit 0 even on the fail-closed path. Exit 2 there shows only "hook exited with code 2" and discards both stdout and stderr, so the operator would lose the reason. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
